headline: Base Changes Mark the Active Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledgers have shifted in Marban Hollow, Weathered Expanse and Linn Mercy. Marban now lists five Colonial bases, two Warden and one neutral, against the earlier count of three, four and one; four events were recorded there in the latest two hours. Weathered Expanse stands at six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral, while Linn Mercy lists nine Colonial, one Warden and one neutral. Callum’s Cape now has four Warden, two Colonial and one neutral base, with two events in the latest two hours. Mooring County’s count is unchanged at ten Warden, one Colonial and one neutral, though six events were logged in that same interval. Stonecradle recorded six events in two hours while all nine bases remained Colonial-held. By contrast, Godcrofts remains wholly Colonial-held and quiet in the latest hours. Casualty and enlistment rates have accelerated on several active fronts, but the war remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
